# 2018-2022 Completion of College Rate

```{r}
install.packages("psych")
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)  # For descriptive statistics

# Read the dataset
data <- read.csv("../Dataset/v1_2023_gbif_ny.csv")

# Filter the data
data_filtered <- subset(data, Sum_Percent_Land_Use_Agricultural > 0.05)

education_levels <- data_filtered$X2018.2022.Completion.of.College.Rate

proportion_gbif_observations_ag <- data_filtered$GBIF_Agricultural_Disparity

proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations <- data_filtered$Percent_Agricultural_Land_Near_GBIF

# Assign variables for analysis
education_levels <- data_filtered$X2018.2022.Completion.of.College.Rate
proportion_gbif_observations_ag <- data_filtered$GBIF_Agricultural_Disparity
proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations <- data_filtered$Percent_Agricultural_Land_Near_GBIF

# ---------------------------------
# 1. Descriptive Statistics
# ---------------------------------
cat("Descriptive Statistics for All Variables:\n")
describe(data_filtered[, c("X2018.2022.Completion.of.College.Rate", 
                           "GBIF_Agricultural_Disparity", 
                           "Percent_Agricultural_Land_Near_GBIF")])

# ---------------------------------
# 2. Normality Tests (Shapiro-Wilk)
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nNormality Test Results:\n")

shapiro_edu <- shapiro.test(education_levels)
shapiro_gbif <- shapiro.test(proportion_gbif_observations_ag)
shapiro_ag_lands <- shapiro.test(proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations)

print("Shapiro Test - College Completion Rates")
print(shapiro_edu)

print("Shapiro Test - GBIF Agricultural Disparity")
print(shapiro_gbif)

print("Shapiro Test - Percent Agricultural Land >1km GBIF")
print(shapiro_ag_lands)

# ---------------------------------
# 3. Correlation Analysis
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nCorrelation Analysis:\n")

# Pearson (if normal) or Spearman correlation tests
cor_test_edu_gbif <- cor.test(education_levels, proportion_gbif_observations_ag, method = "spearman")
cor_test_edu_aglands <- cor.test(education_levels, proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations, method = "spearman")
cor_test_gbif_aglands <- cor.test(proportion_gbif_observations_ag, proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations, method = "spearman")

print("Spearman Correlation - Education Levels vs GBIF Disparity")
print(cor_test_edu_gbif)

print("Spearman Correlation - Education Levels vs Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF")
print(cor_test_edu_aglands)

print("Spearman Correlation - GBIF Disparity vs Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF")
print(cor_test_gbif_aglands)

# ---------------------------------
# 4. Scatterplots with Trendlines
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nGenerating Scatterplots...\n")

# Scatterplot 1: Education Levels vs GBIF Disparity
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = education_levels, y = proportion_gbif_observations_ag)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Education Levels vs GBIF Agricultural Disparity",
       x = "College Completion Rate (%)",
       y = "GBIF Agricultural Disparity")

# Scatterplot 2: Education Levels vs Percent Ag Lands Near GBIF
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = education_levels, y = proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "green") +
  labs(title = "Education Levels vs Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF",
       x = "College Completion Rate (%)",
       y = "Percent Agricultural Land >1km GBIF")

# Scatterplot 3: GBIF Disparity vs Percent Ag Lands Near GBIF
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = proportion_gbif_observations_ag, y = proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "GBIF Agricultural Disparity vs Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF",
       x = "GBIF Agricultural Disparity",
       y = "Percent Agricultural Land >1km GBIF")

# ---------------------------------
# 5. Regression Analysis (Optional)
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nRunning Regression Models...\n")

# Regression 1: Education Levels -> GBIF Agricultural Disparity
model1 <- lm(proportion_gbif_observations_ag ~ education_levels, data = data_filtered)
summary_model1 <- summary(model1)
print("Regression - Education Levels predicting GBIF Disparity")
print(summary_model1)

# Regression 2: Education Levels -> Percent Ag Lands Near GBIF
model2 <- lm(proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations ~ education_levels, data = data_filtered)
summary_model2 <- summary(model2)
print("Regression - Education Levels predicting Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF")
print(summary_model2)

# Regression 3: GBIF Disparity -> Percent Ag Lands Near GBIF
model3 <- lm(proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations ~ proportion_gbif_observations_ag, data = data_filtered)
summary_model3 <- summary(model3)
print("Regression - GBIF Disparity predicting Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF")
print(summary_model3)
```

# 2022 Unemployment Rate

proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations <- data_filtered$Percent_Agricultural_Land_Near_GBIF

unemployment_rate <- data_filtered$X2022.Unemployment.Rate

# ---------------------------------
# 1. Descriptive Statistics
# ---------------------------------

#                          "GBIF_Agricultural_Disparity", 
#                         "Percent_Agricultural_Land_Near_GBIF")])

# ---------------------------------
# 2. Normality Tests (Shapiro-Wilk)
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nNormality Test Results:\n")

shapiro_edu <- shapiro.test(unemployment_rate)
shapiro_gbif <- shapiro.test(proportion_gbif_observations_ag)
shapiro_ag_lands <- shapiro.test(proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations)

print("Shapiro Test - College Completion Rates")

print("Shapiro Test - GBIF Agricultural Disparity")

print("Shapiro Test - Percent Agricultural Land >1km GBIF")
print(shapiro_ag_lands)

# ---------------------------------
# 3. Correlation Analysis
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nCorrelation Analysis:\n")

# Pearson (if normal) or Spearman correlation tests
cor_test_edu_gbif <- cor.test(unemployment_rate, proportion_gbif_observations_ag, method = "spearman")
cor_test_edu_aglands <- cor.test(unemployment_rate, proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations, method = "spearman")
cor_test_gbif_aglands <- cor.test(proportion_gbif_observations_ag, proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations, method = "spearman")

print("Spearman Correlation - Education Levels vs GBIF Disparity")
print(cor_test_edu_gbif)

print("Spearman Correlation - Education Levels vs Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF")
print(cor_test_edu_aglands)

print("Spearman Correlation - GBIF Disparity vs Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF")
print(cor_test_gbif_aglands)

# ---------------------------------
# 4. Scatterplots with Trendlines
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nGenerating Scatterplots...\n")

# Scatterplot 1: Unemployment Levels vs GBIF Disparity
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = unemployment_rate, y = proportion_gbif_observations_ag)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Unemployment Rate vs GBIF Agricultural Disparity",
       x = "Unemployment (%)",
       y = "GBIF Agricultural Disparity")

# Scatterplot 2: Unemployment Levels vs Percent Ag Lands Near GBIF
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = unemployment_rate, y = proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "green") +
  labs(title = "Unemployment Rate vs Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF",
       x = "Unemployment Rate (%)",
       y = "Percent Agricultural Land >1km GBIF")

# Scatterplot 3: GBIF Disparity vs Percent Ag Lands Near GBIF
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = proportion_gbif_observations_ag, y = proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "GBIF Agricultural Disparity vs Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF",
       x = "GBIF Agricultural Disparity",
       y = "Percent Agricultural Land >1km GBIF")

# ---------------------------------
# 5. Regression Analysis (Optional)
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nRunning Regression Models...\n")

# Regression 1: Education Levels -> GBIF Agricultural Disparity
model1 <- lm(proportion_gbif_observations_ag ~ unemployment_rate, data = data_filtered)
summary_model1 <- summary(model1)
print("Regression - Unemployment rate predicting GBIF Disparity")
print(summary_model1)

# Regression 2: Education Levels -> Percent Ag Lands Near GBIF
model2 <- lm(proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations ~ unemployment_rate, data = data_filtered)
summary_model2 <- summary(model2)
print("Regression - Unemployment rate predicting Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF")
print(summary_model2)

# Regression 3: GBIF Disparity -> Percent Ag Lands Near GBIF
model3 <- lm(proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations ~ proportion_gbif_observations_ag, data = data_filtered)
summary_model3 <- summary(model3)
print("Regression - GBIF Disparity predicting Percent Ag Lands >1km GBIF")
print(summary_model3)
